beats.say: Richard E Grant admits betrayal to Joe Lycett.
Evening Standard reports he told Joe Lycett he was a Traitor in the first episode.
Maya Jama and Richard E Grant began as the original Traitors.
James Acaster was later recruited into their coven.
The winner's charity can receive up to one hundred thousand pounds.
Richard E Grant's early confession changes the game from the start.

meta.title: Richard E Grant admits betrayal to Joe Lycett
meta.alt_title: Maya Jama and Richard E Grant start as Traitors
meta.summary: Richard E Grant reveals he is a Traitor to Joe Lycett in the first episode of Celebrity Traitors 2026, while Maya Jama and James Acaster complete the coven playing for up to £100,000 for charity.
meta.comment: Who would you trust in the Traitors castle?
sources: Evening Standard, Celebrity Traitors 2026: Who will be banished and who is tipped to win?, 2026-10-08
facts: Maya Jama and Richard E Grant were the original Traitors, with James Acaster later recruited as the third member of their coven.
Richard E Grant explicitly told Joe Lycett that he was a Traitor in the first episode.
The Traitors chose to recruit James Acaster into their coven.
There is a cash prize of up to £100,000 for the winner's chosen charity.
